Base pay range ₹1,500,000.00/yr - ₹2,800,000.00/yr Job Description Responsibilities: - Build and ship features end-to-end. Write backend services in Go, Java, or other strictly typed languages, build frontend interfaces in Angular, and own the full stack for the features you deliver. - Own features from design through production. Take responsibility for technical design, implementation, deployment, and monitoring, not just writing code. - Write clean, testable, well-documented code. Maintain high engineering standards in a codebase that powers critical healthcare workflows. - Participate in system design for new features and platform capabilities. Contribute to API design, data modeling, and service architecture decisions. - Review code thoughtfully. Catch bugs, suggest improvements, and share knowledge through constructive code reviews - Work closely with product and design to translate requirements into technical solutions. Push back when something doesn't make sense; propose alternatives when you see a better way. - Improve engineering practices. Contribute to testing, CI/CD, observability, and developer tooling that make the team more effective. - Debug and resolve production issues quickly. When things break in production, you dig in, find the root cause, and fix it. - Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and design discussions. Requirements: - 3-5 years of professional software engineering experience building production systems. - Strong proficiency in Go, Java, or other strictly typed languages (experience with Python, PHP, or Node.js is also valued). - Experience building frontend applications with Angular (or a comparable modern framework like React or Vue). - Solid understanding of relational databases (MySQL). Schema design, query optimization, and indexing strategies; you know how to make data work well. - Experience with cloud infrastructure, AWS preferred. You're comfortable deploying and operating services in the cloud. - Strong system design fundamentals. API design, data modeling, and service architecture; you can reason about how systems fit together. - Testing discipline. You write unit tests and integration tests as a natural part of your development workflow. - Comfortable with git, CI/CD, and modern development workflows. You've worked in teams that ship frequently and review code rigorously. - Strong communication skills. You can explain technical trade-offs clearly, write good documentation, and collaborate effectively across functions. - B. Tech. /B. E. in Computer Science or equivalent. Company Summary NuvertOS is a health tech company that aims to digitize and streamline complete healthcare processes. Healthtech is a fragmented system where multiple systems are required to manage the workflow which makes the entire process difficult. Having collective experience of more than 10 years in health tech helped us to understand these issues and solve them at the root level. We at NuvertOS simplified this and came up with one system to replace all. Our solution is equipped with customized workflows enabling the setup to personalize the system as per their requirements. jobs.description: Software Engineer 2 Care.fi Gurugram, Haryana, India 23 hours ago Over 200 applicants See who Care.fi has hired for this role Apply Save Report this job The role An SDE 2 at CareFi owns problems, not tickets. You will take a business outcome, work out what needs to be built, design it, ship it, and stay accountable for how it behaves in production. This is a backend-leaning role on a small team, which means your work will show up in front of hospital staff, ops teams and borrowers within weeks. You will have real say in architecture, and real responsibility when something breaks at 11pm on a discharge that has to clear tonight. What you will own - Design and deliver backend services end to end: scoping, data modelling, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and the fixes that follow - Write a lightweight design doc for anything that spans more than one service or one engineer, and get it reviewed before you build - Model and evolve financial and claims data correctly. Ledgers, disbursements, repayments and reconciliation have to be right the first time, and auditable afterwards - Build and maintain integrations with hospitals, insurers, payment providers and logistics partners, including the messy ones with no sandbox and a PDF for documentation - Raise technical risk, feasibility concerns and scope creep before work starts rather than in the retro - Review code substantively. Explain the reasoning behind a change request, not just the change - Mentor SDE 1s and interns through pairing, intentional PR reviews, and unblocking them early - Own incidents in your domain: triage, mitigate, write the post-incident review, close the action items - Identify tech debt in the areas you touch and propose a concrete fix alongside the flag - Keep the documentation for your systems current after every release What we work with - Backend: NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL - Cloud and infra: Azure (AKS), containerised services, GitLab CI/CD - Adjacent: React Native and Flutter clients, OCR and document extraction pipelines, internal ops tooling - Ways of working: sprint-based delivery, design docs, PR review culture, blameless post-incident reviews. You do not need prior NestJS experience. Strong Node and TypeScript fundamentals transfer in a week or two. What we are looking for - 5 to 7 years building and running backend systems in production, with at least 3 years in a typed language on a modern service framework (Node/TypeScript, Java, Go, Python) - Strong relational database skills: schema design, indexing, query performance, transactions and isolation levels. You can explain why a migration is safe under load - Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of at least one non-trivial system or service, including what it cost you to operate it - Practical experience with API design, third party integrations, idempotency, retries and failure handling - Comfort with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD. You can deploy, observe and debug your own service without waiting for someone else - Testing as a default habit, not a compliance step - Clear written communication. Design docs, PR descriptions and incident notes are part of the job - Evidence of lifting other engineers: mentoring, reviews, standards, or documentation people actually use Show more Show less Seniority level Entry level Employment type Full-time Industries Financial Services Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Care.fi by 2x See who you know
